'''Walking Enderman Heads''' are the [[Walking Heads]] of [[Assimilated Enderman|Assimilated Endermen]].

==''Spawning''==
*Spawned with a 50% chance when an Assimilated Enderman dies.
*Spawned by [[Worm|Worms]] through Level 3 [[Scent System|Scents]].

==''Behavior''==
Walking Enderman Heads are Hit and Run Offensive Support units and Melee swarm units.

* Walking Enderman Heads' Melee Attack is performed through contact damage.
* Walking Enderman Heads can perform small leaps.
* Walking Enderman Heads are able to teleport themselves as well as nearby [[Assimilated Wolf|Assimilated Wolves]], [[Rupter|Rupters]] and other [[Walking Heads]]. Their teleportation Ability is based on the following logic:
** Upon spotting a player, the teleportation noise will play.
** Walking Enderman Heads can not teleport within the first 4 seconds of finding a target.
** Walking Enderman Heads will not teleport if within 10 blocks of the target.
** After they manage to teleport, they will teleport a nearby Assimilated Wolf, Rupter or Walking Head.
** 2 damage will be inflicted to the teleported mob (unless it is another Walking Enderman Head).
** The ability to teleport other Parasites has a cooldown of 2 seconds. This cooldown is removed if the Walking Enderman Head takes damage or has the [[Rage]] effect.
** If a Walking Enderman Head is on fire, there is a 75% chance the mob it teleports will also catch fire.
* Any Mob within 3 blocks of a Walking Enderman Head will be inflicted with [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]]. This does not go through walls.
* They will seek out [[Medium Incomplete Form|Medium Incomplete Forms]] to merge with in order to evolve back into Assimilated Endermen.
* Walking Enderman Heads are able to traverse faster in liquids by performing small leaps.

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===

* Walking Enderman Heads, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
